action.content: Write a cover letter for a job in Ventura that is funny and would be enjoyed by someone named Darius, wrap the entire response in double quotation marks.
action.label: context

action.content:
"Dear Darius,

I am writing to apply for the open position in Ventura because, unlike the rest of the world, I have already mastered the art of finding the perfect spot to park my car while avoiding the 'No Parking' signs that seem to be placed specifically to test my patience. I understand that your team values efficiency, but I believe that a job well done should also include a moment to enjoy a fresh avocado toast while watching the ocean breeze blow through your hair.

I am confident that my ability to navigate the winding roads of Ventura with the same ease as a local surfer, combined with my knack for turning mundane tasks into a fun adventure, will make you the envy of your colleagues. Whether we are tackling projects or just enjoying a casual coffee break, I promise to bring the same energy and humor that makes Ventura so special.

Thank you for considering an applicant who is ready to work hard, laugh often, and never miss a sunset.

Sincerely,
Your Future Ventura Team Member"
action.label: response
